objective: Milestone 12: Delivery Circuit Breaker, XML Sitemap Parser and Qualification Equivalence

tasks.description: Implement outbound delivery circuit breaker and dead-letter queue (DLQ) policy manager to track consecutive delivery provider failures per channel (email, telegram), transition states across CLOSED, OPEN, and HALF_OPEN, enforce cooldown periods, and manage DLQ routing and replay.
acceptance_criteria: evaluateCircuitState(channel, options) evaluates channel health, failure counters, and trip thresholds (e.g. 5 consecutive 5xx/timeout failures trips to OPEN for 15-minute cooldown)
recordDeliveryOutcome(channel, outcome, options) transitions state to HALF_OPEN after cooldown expiry to test single probes, resetting to CLOSED on success or tripping back to OPEN on failure
routeToDeadLetterQueue(intent, reason, options) routes permanently exhausted delivery intents (exceeded max retries or fatal non-retryable recipient error) to DLQ with metadata and error diagnostics
replayDeadLetterQueue(criteria, options) provides safe in-memory / SQL-compatible batch re-queueing of eligible DLQ intents once transport health is restored
Deterministic in-memory domain state transitions conforming to delivery intent queue contracts with zero uncaught exceptions
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/delivery-circuit-breaker.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement automated XML sitemap parser and admission page discoverer supporting sitemaps.org XML protocol, nested sitemap indexes, change frequency and priority weighting, and domain restriction guards.
acceptance_criteria: parseSitemapXml(xmlContent, baseOrigin, options) parses <urlset> and <sitemapindex> XML documents into normalized sitemap entry records
Extracts canonical <loc>, <lastmod>, <changefreq>, and <priority> elements, resolving relative links against source origin
Filters out cross-domain links, malformed URLs, and excluded path patterns according to source robots policy directives
Handles gzipped XML buffers, missing optional tags, large URL sets (up to 50,000 URLs), and malformed XML safely without crash
Pure domain logic and safe error handling conforming to research collection interfaces
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/sitemap-parser.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement international academic qualification and degree level equivalence evaluator to map diverse global education credentials into standardized tiers, score field-of-study relevance, and evaluate minimum degree eligibility criteria for opportunities.
acceptance_criteria: normalizeQualification(credential, options) standardizes global academic credentials (high school, vocational diploma, Associate, Bachelor's, Master's, PhD) into ordered hierarchical levels

evaluateQualificationEligibility(applicantProfile, opportunityRules, options) verifies if an applicant's academic background meets or exceeds minimum degree prerequisites (e.g. Master's satisfies Bachelor's requirement)
scoreFieldRelevance(applicantDiscipline, targetTopics, options) computes discipline affinity scores (e.g. Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Computer Science vs. general STEM)
Handles unrecognized credentials gracefully with structured review_required uncertainty flags rather than false rejections
Pure in-memory domain logic with deterministic scoring and comprehensive validation
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/qualification-equivalence.test.ts && npm run typecheck
